description: Microbiology request: general determination = untargeted identification of a microorganism by any method (MII KDS Mikrobiologie 2027, profile MII_PR_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Bestimmung, ValueSet MII_VS_Mikrobio_Allgemeine_Bestimmung_Tests_LOINC). Of the six enumerated module codes only three are in the ontology (11475-1 culture, and two sequencing/organism-group codes); the preferred 41852-5 'Microorganism or agent identified in Specimen' is NOT in the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. The ontology pattern is Property = Presence or identity with the organism (or organism group: Bacteria, Fungi, virus) in 'Inheres in'.
